exclude.reason: CanvasDocumentView uses a document page grid and compact document status bar, independently of the host application gutter. Text, controls, contrast, overflow and table checks still apply.

DiffViewer preserves complete code lines in a horizontal scroller, with two compact line-number gutters. The code-diff profile checks its 12px monospace type, 18px lines and 6/8px cell insets; annotations and ordinary controls retain their own checks.
ChangeLocation is a hunk coordinate strip: text follows the @@ marker. Its explicit profile checks the 8px strip inset; control, contrast and overflow checks remain active.
ChangeDiff has a +/- gutter before prose. Its explicit profile checks 8px insets and 8px marker gap; contrast, wrapping and overflow remain checked.

RichChatComposer mode controls follow the composer border (12px docked, 8px compact), not the page reading gutter. composer.surface still checks the outer placement; composer.mode-inset checks this inner grid, and all control/focus/contrast checks remain active.

ProcedureSteps has a numbered/bulleted marker column (24px md or 20px sm) plus a 12px gap before its prose and code. The procedure profile checks this anatomy; text, contrast, overflow and controls are still checked.
The SourceCard row title/meta column follows a 32px file mark and 12px gap. Its source-row profile checks the marker, gap and outer insets; the row control and neighboring content remain checked.
Select labels follow the trigger inset, not the page gutter. Explicit select profiles check both inset sizes and variants; trigger typography, focus, containment and the popup remain checked.

MessageRow has a 20px avatar slot and 8px gap, inside ChatPanel’s 8px hover inset (36px text / 8px actions from the transcript edge). The chat.message profiles enforce this anatomy; continued rows retain the slot, own bubbles reverse it. Only row content uses this grid; ordinary neighbors and control/contrast/overflow checks remain active.

RichChatComposer toolbar follows the composer boundary with 8px docked / 6px compact side padding. Explicit composer.tools-inset rules check this inner grid; outer dock, controls, contrast and focus remain measured.

MarkdownView inline code uses a 4px background inset within the paragraph. markdown.inline-code-inset checks its padding and zero margins; only the code token uses this profile, while paragraph neighbors, type and contrast remain checked.
